name: Egoist Curiosity v0.0
desc:
Egoist Curiosity is a football game inspired by Blue Lock, focused on unique gameplay, team coordination, and competitive matches.

--
🔹 Main features:

Unique gameplay

Strong focus on teamwork

Dynamic matches

Different playstyles for each role on the field

--

Controls:

Q - Tackle
E - Dribble
C - Dash
R - Throw or Ask Pass
T - Special
F - Trap
G - Flow
Double Space - Header
